name: Turn (sharp)
spec: yellow diamond with a black right-angle turn arrow
meaning: A sharp turn ahead; slow down before it.

snippets.back: Use hand signals when bright sunlight or a line of following vehicles could hide the vehicle's turn signals.
Before the road test the examiner checks that the vehicle is safe and has brake lights, left and right turn signals, and a horn.
The guide calls for a turn signal at least one hundred feet before a lane change, turn, merge, or parking maneuver.
A flashing Train Approaching sign warns that a train is coming, while the combined U-turn and left turn sign marks the signal-controlled turns used to cross the tracks.
Directional turn signals must be installed and working.
If headlights fail, try the parking lights and turn signals; on a dark empty road, slow down on the pavement before moving onto the shoulder.
Cancel a turn signal after completing the turn or lane change so it does not give others a false message.
Watch truck turn signals and allow enough space for the truck to maneuver without moving into its blind spots.

result.summary: No snippet describes a sharp turn warning sign shape/colour or its meaning; all snippets concern vehicle turn signals only.
